verses.text: Ix k'och winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' t'a chonhab' Derbe. Ix b'atxi heb' winh ta', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Listra. Hata' ix yil-lajel sb'a heb' winh yet' jun winh creyente skuch Timoteo. Ha jun winh chi', a jun ix creyente israel ay yune' winh, haxo winh smam winh, griego winh.
Ha heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Listra yet' t'a Iconio ix laj yal heb' smasanil to te' wach' sb'eyb'al winhaj Timoteo chi'.

Ix sna'an winhaj Pablo chi' to ol yik'b'at winh yet'ok. Yuj chi' ix ak'ji circuncidar winh yuj winh, yik max kot yowal heb' israel t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj ol ek' heb' winh chi', yujto yojtak heb' to griego winh smam winh.

Haxo t'a junjun chonhab' b'ajtak ix laj ek' heb' winh, ix yalanel heb' winh juntzanh cheknab'il alb'il yuj heb' winh schekab' Jesús yet' heb' winh anciano ay t'a Jerusalén. Ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' creyente to yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal juntzanh cheknab'il chi'.
Haxo heb' creyente t'a junjun chonhab' chi', ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al yak'nak och heb' t'a sk'o'ol chi'. Sk'ib' pax sb'isul heb' t'a junjun k'u.
Snib'ej heb' winh sb'at yalel slolonel Dios t'a yol yik Asia, palta haxo Yespíritu Dios maj cha'anb'atlaj heb' winh. Yuj chi' ha t'a yol yik Frigia yet' t'a Galacia ix b'at heb' winh.
Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a sti' smojonal yol yik Misia, ix sna'an heb' winh to ha t'a yol yik Bitinia sb'at heb' winh. Palta haxo Yespíritu Dios maj cha'anb'atlaj heb' winh ta'.
Yuj chi' ix k'axpajek' heb' winh t'a sti' yol yik Misia chi'. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Troas, haton jun ay t'a sti' ha' mar.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal, icha t'a wayich ix aj yilan jun winh aj Macedonia winhaj Pablo chi', linhanek' winh ix yil winh. Ix tewi'och winh t'a winh: “Kotanh t'a Macedonia. Kolwajanh t'ayonh,” xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yilan jun chi' winhaj Pablo chi', ix kak'an lista ko b'a yik tzonh b'at t'a Macedonia chi'. Yujto ix kojtakejeli to ha Dios ix ak'an kopisio kalanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'a heb' anima chi'.
Ichato chi', ix onh och t'a yol jun barco t'a chonhab' Troas chi'. Te t'inhannhej ix onh b'ati, ix onh k'och t'a yol yik Samotracia. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix onh k'och t'a jun chonhab' skuch Neápolis.

Ixlajwi chi', ix onh b'atxi, ix onh k'och t'a chonhab' Filipos. Ha jun chonhab' chi', haxo t'a yol yik Roma ay. Anhej te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Macedonia chi'. Hata' ix onh ek' jaye' k'uhal.

Haxo t'a jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip ix onh b'at t'a sti' jun ha' niwan ha' t'a sti'el chonhab'. Hata' xit'taxon ek' anima lesal. Haxo ix onh k'och ta', ix onh em k'ojan. Ix kalanel wach' ab'ix t'a juntzanh heb' ix ix toxonton smolb'ej sb'a ta'.

Hata' ay jun ix skuch Lidia, aj chonhab' Tiatira ix. Ha k'apak k'apak k'ik' mutz'inak te caro stojol schonh ix. Syak' wal och Dios ix t'a sk'o'ol. Ayik wan yab'an jun ab'ix chi' ix, haxo Kajal Jesús ix jakan spensar ix. Yuj chi' ix yak' wal och spensar ix t'a tas ix yal winhaj Pablo chi'.

Ix ak'ji bautizar ix yet' jantak heb' junnhej yaj yet' ix t'a yol spat. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan ix t'ayonh: --Tato tzeyila' to yel swak'och Kajal Jesús t'a in k'o'ol, ol ex b'at wet' t'a in pat. Wach' tzex aj ta', xchi ix t'ayonh. Ix tewi'och ix t'ayonh, yuj chi' ix onh aj ta'.

Haxo junel, ayik wan ko b'at b'aj slesalwi heb' anima, ix k'och jun ix kob'es ix t'ayonh. Ayoch jun enemigo t'a ix. Yuj chi' na'umel lolonel ix. Junelnhej ayoch ix chekab'ok t'a juntzanh winak. Ha juntzanh winak chi', syak' wal ganar tumin heb' winh t'a spatik ix, yujto syal ix tastak toto ol ujok.

Ix och tzak'an ix ku'uj yet' winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix syamanoch ix yawaji, syalan ix: --Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik, schekab' ton wal Dios yaj heb' winh, haton jun Dios yelxo niwan yelk'ochi. Wan yalan heb' winh t'ayex tas tz'aj he kolchaji, xchi ix.

Tzijtum el ix ek' ix ket'ok. Anhej wal jun chi' syal ix t'a juntak el. Haxo winhaj Pablo chi', majxo techaj yuj winh yab'ani. Yuj chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh t'a ix. Ix yalan winh t'a jun enemigo chi': --Swal t'ayach t'a sb'i Jesucristo, elanh t'a ix, xchi winh t'ay. T'a jun rato chi' ix el t'a ix.

Palta haxo ix yilan heb' winh b'aj chekab' yaj ix chi' to ix el jun enemigo chi' t'a ix, to maxtzak yal-laj yak'an ganar stumin heb' winh t'a spatik ix. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yajal.
Ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh juez. Ix yalan heb' winh b'aj chekab' yaj ix chi' icha tik: --Ha heb' winh israel tik, tonhej tzul yak' somchajel ko chonhab' tik heb' winh.
Wan sk'ayb'an heb' anima heb' winh yet' juntzanh b'eyb'al ay yowalil yuj ley. Max yal ko k'ulan juntzanh chi' a onh tik yujto aj Roma onh, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo heb' anima ayek' ta', ix te kot yowal heb' t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Silas chi'. Haxo heb' winh juez ix chekan ik'jokel spichul heb' winh schawanhil. Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan mak'jok heb' winh heb' winh t'a te' jixk'ab' te'.

Manh jantakok ix aj heb' winh yik'ani. Ixlajwi chi', ix yumji'och heb' winh t'a preso. Ix yalan heb' winh juez chi' t'a winh stanhwumal preso chi': --Tza tanhwej wal heb' winh sik'lab'il, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix b'at winh yak'kanoch heb' winh t'a jun cuarto t'a slajwub'xo k'ochi. Ix yak'anoch yok heb' winh t'a slot'il jun te' cepo.

Haxo t'ak'walil, ix lesalwi winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi'. Ix sb'itan juntzanh b'it heb' winh t'a Dios. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh t'a preso chi', ix yab' heb' sb'itan heb' winh. Haxo t'a chimilak'wal

ix ek' jun niwan kixkab', te ow ix yutej sb'a. Ix laj ib'xik'e yich preso chi'. Haxo t'a jun rato chi', munil ix laj jakwi spuerta'il jun preso chi' smasanil. Haxo k'e'en cadena ayoch t'a heb' preso chi', ix laj elta chokoljok k'e'en.

Haxo ix el swayanh winh tanhwum preso chi', ix yilan winh to jakanxo jantaknhej spuerta'il preso chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'k'eta k'e'en yespada winh t'a yol yatut yik smilancham sb'a winh sna'ani. Ha sna'an winh to ix b'at heb' elelal smasanil.
Palta haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix awajelta t'a winh: --Manh a milcham a b'a, ayonh ek' ko masanil, xchielta winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'ankot sk'ak' winh. Ix och winh b'aj ay heb' chi'. Ix te ib'xik'e winh yuj xiwelal. Ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta heb' winh chawanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ex mamin, ¿tas yowalil tzin k'ulej yik tzin kolchaji? xchi winh.
--Ak'och Kajal Jesucristo t'a a k'o'ol, yik wach' ol ach kolchaj yet' jantak heb' junnhej yaj et' t'a yol a pat, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan slolonel Kajal Jesús heb' winh t'a winh yet' t'a jantak heb' ayek' t'a yol spat winh.

Hanheja' t'a jun rato chi' ix b'ikji'el schik'il heb' winh b'aj ix lajwi smak'ji chi' yuj winh tanhwum preso chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a winh yet' heb' junnhej yaj yet' winh t'a yol spat chi'.
Ichato chi' ix ak'ji'och heb' winh yuj winh t'a yol spat. Ix ak'ji wa heb' winh yuj winh. Ix te tzalaj winh yet' heb' kajanek' yet' chi' yujto ix yak'och Dios heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, ix chekjib'at juntzanh heb' winh polenkía yuj heb' winh juez. Ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winh tanhwum preso chi' to tz'el winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Silas chi' t'a libre.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Pablo chi': --Ix in cha jun órden yuj heb' winh juez chi', tob' tzex wak'el t'a libre. Yuj chi' ixikek. Paxanhek t'a tzalajk'olal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb' winh polenkía chi': --Ha onh tik, aj Roma onh. Maj sk'anb'ej yab' heb' winh tato ay ko mul. Palta ina ix onh smak' heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Haxo tikne'ik, ¿tom snib'ej heb' winh t'a elk'altak tzonh yak'el t'a libre? Manh ol onh el-laj. Kotokab' heb' winh juez chi'. Ha wal lak'an heb' winh ol onh ik'anelok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh yal t'a heb' winh juez chi'. Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' winh to aj Roma heb' winh, ix te xiwk'e heb' winh.

Haxo wal lak'an heb' winh ix b'at k'anan niwank'olal sb'a t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Silas chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'ji'elta heb' winh yuj heb' winh t'a preso chi'. --Sko k'an pawor t'ayex, komonok tzex el t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi heb' winh juez chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi yelta heb' winh t'a preso chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a spat ix Lidia. Ix sk'umlan sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' creyente. Ix ak'jikan yip sk'o'ol heb' yuj heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atxi heb' winh.
